mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed equity discount rates.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals a 'liquidity trap' scenario, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE and FEDFUNDS does not produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of continued monetary easing and fiscal stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600 thousand units, it signals a recovery in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower industrial production (INDPRO) level signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO and 5-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 220, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of housing starts (HOUST) above 500 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 signals a synchronized recovery in housing and manufacturing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and INDPRO does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.
